title: A notify target to add
description: A webhook that receives notifications from the owner's agents, and the secret that signs them.

name.description: The target's name. An agent sends to this target when its definition sets notify to this name, for example notify: ops. Use up to 32 letters, digits, - and _.

url.description: The HTTPS URL that notifications are posted to. Wardrik checks the URL when you add the target and before each notification. It doesn't follow redirects.

secret.description: A secret in the owner's vault. Wardrik uses it to sign the body of each notification. Wardrik reads it each time, so a new value applies immediately.

name.description: The name of the secret in the owner's vault.
